Native Salesforce observations from an isolated scratch org, using anonymous Apex and named tests at matching source and transport APIs 62.0 and 67.0. A custom object had Number formula fields of declared scale 2: blank=Num__c + 1 with BlankAsBlank; zero=Num__c + 1 with BlankAsZero; rounded=ROUND(Num__c / 3, 2) with BlankAsBlank; value=IF(ISBLANK(Text__c), 0, VALUE(Text__c)) with BlankAsBlank. Inputs empty, null, numeric respectively used Num__c=0 and blank Text__c; Num__c=null and Text__c=null; Num__c=1.25 and Text__c='12.5'. org.tsv rows 2–13 retain only queried formula values. Overprecision, rounding policy at the output boundary, formula evaluation APIs, and other output types were not measured.

Supplementary source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0 anonymous and named controls appear in supplement.tsv rows 2–25. Each queried formula uses BlankAsBlank: Num__c+1 at Number scales 0, 2, 3 and Currency scale 2, plus BLANKVALUE(Num__c,7)+1 and IF(ISBLANK(Num__c),7,Num__c)+1 at Number scale 2. Non-tie values, null and explicit fallbacks were observed; half ties were not part of this run.

The independent tie controls at source and transport APIs 62.0 and 67.0, on both routes, appear in ties.tsv rows 2–25. The Number scale-zero formula is Num__c+1 with BlankAsBlank. Signed half ties round away from zero in these observations.

Operations and query-surface controls: operations.tsv rows 2-21 and surfaces.tsv rows 2-61, source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and named routes, isolated scratch org deleted and verified gone. Custom object with Number (scale 2) formulas on one Number input, BlankAsBlank unless marked: Num__c-1, 1-Num__c, Num__c*2, -Num__c, Num__c^2, Num__c/2, IF(Num__c+1>0,1,2), MAX(Num__c+1,5), ABS(Num__c-1); BlankAsZero Num__c*2 and Num__c-1; Currency BlankAsBlank Num__c*2 and Num__c-1; Num__c/3 under BlankAsZero (Div3Z) and BlankAsBlank (Div3B). Inputs null, 0, 2, 1.25, -1.25 per case, plus six rows of 1 for the surface queries. Surfaces: COUNT() with WHERE on Div3Z/Div3B equality and range, null filters on Mul/Sub, SUM/AVG/COUNT aggregates, ORDER BY Mul ASC NULLS FIRST. All four runs returned identical values. The permission set Probe_Access was assigned before the runs; without it API 67 DML rejected the insert for field access.

Function controls: functions.tsv rows 2-21, same scratch-org method, both routes at API 62.0 and 67.0, org deleted and verified gone, all four runs identical. Number (scale 2) formulas, BlankAsBlank, on the same Num__c with inputs null, 0, 2, 1.25, -1.25: FLOOR(Num__c-1), CEILING(Num__c+1), MIN(Num__c+1,5), MAX(5,Num__c+1), MOD(Num__c+1,3), SQRT/EXP/LN/LOG(Num__c+1), BLANKVALUE and NULLVALUE(Num__c+1,7), IF(ISBLANK(Num__c+1),9,Num__c+1), IF(ISNULL(Num__c-1),9,1), (Num__c+1)*2, ROUND(Num__c*3,0), LEN(TEXT(Num__c+1)), MAX(Num__c+1,5), ABS(Num__c-1). POWER is not a formula function in this org and was dropped.

Currency function controls: currency_functions.tsv rows 2-21, same method and routes, API 62.0 and 67.0, org deleted and verified gone, all four runs identical. Currency (scale 2) BlankAsBlank formulas on Num__c: ABS(Num__c-1), FLOOR(Num__c-1), MIN and MAX(Num__c+1,5), MOD(Num__c+1,3), ROUND(Num__c*3,0), ROUND(Num__c/3,2), SQRT(Num__c+1), BLANKVALUE(Num__c+1,7), IF(ISBLANK(Num__c+1),9,Num__c+1).
